title: Change Management: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A quick fix on a Friday afternoon seems harmless. Then the whole network goes down. Change management is there to prevent that.

scenes.heading: The five steps
scenes.narration: Every change follows the same path. Someone raises a request for change. Others review the risk. Someone approves it. The change is carried out. Afterwards, the result is reviewed.

scenes.heading: Types of change
scenes.narration: Not every change takes the same route. Standard changes are pre-approved. Normal changes carry more risk. Replacing a core switch is a normal change.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva change management lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Five steps from request to review. Every change needs a rollback plan. Standard changes are pre-approved. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva change management lab.
